environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, exposed directly via an Elastic IP on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer or proxy in front of the application. The instance runs the Python application directly with systemd. SQLite database stored at /data/app.db with read-write permissions for the app user.

config.network: Elastic IP, SG ingress TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0
